method: Original setter entry routines executed natively in Unicorn; the call into the controller wrapper 0x18b8380 and the dynamic virtual 0xa0 pose store are replaced by recording services (the pose service also mutates the controller slot in some cases).
comparisons: service calls and register arguments (controller, body; body and 4x12-byte pose rows)
every byte of body (0x200), metadata (0x60) and holder (0x40) fixtures after return
coverage: kind nibble 2 and non-2, force byte 0/nonzero including high-bit and bits above r8b
controller slot changed by the pose virtual (reload after call)
random bytes in all unrelated body/metadata fields
limits: Wrapper 0x18b8380 and everything beneath it are not executed here; composition with the other modules is covered only by unit tests.
Pose rows compare 12 of every 16 bytes: native padding words are uninitialised stack.
Synthetic offline fixtures, no live validation, no lock behaviour.
